decisions.reason: The connector-family change is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, which assigns JST-PH to power and JST-GH to signals.
The source changes the interboard power and signal connectors, not the independently specified battery connector interface.
The interboard connector-family decision does not change the battery connector's placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing requirements.
Using JST-GH for interboard signals does not alter the stated I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The connector-family selection does not necessarily change any current board-size, mounting-hole, USB-C-position, aspect-ratio, or enclosure-fit attribute.
The interboard connector-family change does not modify the switched 5V rail's voltage, enable control, converter, pull-down, powered loads, or operating pattern.
